title.zh: 卷七十一 列傳第四十一 孫惠 熊遠 王鑒 陳頵 高崧
title.en: Volume 71 Biographies 41: Sun Hui; Xiong Yuan; Wang Jian; Chen Yun; Gao Song
title.raw: 卷七十一 列傳第四十一 孫惠 熊遠 王鑒 陳頵 高崧 Volume 71 Biographies 41: Sun Hui; Xiong Yuan; Wang Jian; Chen Yun; Gao Song

value.zh: 愍懷太子
value.en: Crown Prince Minhuai
value.literal: Crown Prince Minhuai

value.zh: 時望氣者言廣陵有天子氣，故封為廣陵王，邑五萬戶。
value.en: Astrologers said Guangling bore an emperor's aura, so Yu was made Prince of Guangling with fifty thousand households.
value.literal: At the time, observers of celestial portents said Guangling had the aura of a Son of Heaven; therefore he was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangling with a fief of fifty thousand households.

value.zh: 以劉寔為師，孟珩為友，楊准、馮蓀為文學。
value.en: Liu Shi served as tutor, Meng Heng as companion, and Yang Zhun and Feng Sun as literary aides.
value.literal: Liu Shi was made tutor, Meng Heng companion, and Yang Zhun and Feng Sun literary aides.

value.zh: 惠帝即位，立為皇太子。
value.en: When Hui Di took the throne, Yu was made crown prince.
value.literal: When Emperor Hui succeeded to the throne, he was established as crown prince.

value.zh: 盛選德望以為師傅，以何劭為太師，王戎為太傅，楊濟為太保，裴楷為少師，張華為少傅，和嶠為少保。
value.en: The court recruited eminent tutors—He Shao as Grand Tutor, Wang Rong as Grand Mentor, Yang Ji as Grand Guardian, Pei Kai as Junior Tutor, Zhang Hua as Junior Mentor, and He Qiao as Junior Guardian.
value.literal: Worthy men of virtue and repute were abundantly selected as tutors and guardians: He Shao as Grand Tutor, Wang Rong as Grand Mentor, Yang Ji as Grand Guardian, Pei Kai as Junior Tutor, Zhang Hua as Junior Mentor, and He Qiao as Junior Guardian.

value.zh: 元康元年，出就東宮，又詔曰：「遹尚幼蒙，今出東宮，惟當賴師傅群賢之訓。
value.en: In Yuankang year one he moved to the Eastern Palace, and an edict declared: "Yu is still young and inexperienced; now that he has moved to the Eastern Palace he must rely on his tutors and worthy mentors for instruction.
value.literal: In the first year of Yuankang he moved out to the Eastern Palace; an edict further said: "Yu is still young and untutored; now that he is moving out to the Eastern Palace he should rely solely on the instruction of his tutors and the worthy assembly.

value.zh: 其遊處左右，宜得正人使共周旋，能相長益者。」
value.en: Those about him in leisure and attendance should be upright men who keep company with him and help one another improve."
value.literal: Those who attend him in leisure and service should be upright men who may keep company with him and mutually aid one another's growth."

value.zh: 於是使太保衛瓘息庭、司空泰息略、太子太傅楊濟息毖、太子少師裴楷息憲、太子少傅張華息禕、尚書令華暠息恆與太子游處，以相輔導焉。
value.en: Thereupon Wei Guan's son Ting, Director of Works Tai's son Lue, Yang Ji's son Bi, Pei Kai's son Xian, Zhang Hua's son Yi, and Hua Gao's son Heng were sent to keep company with the crown prince and guide him.
value.literal: Thereupon Grand Guardian Wei Guan's son Ting, Director of Works Tai's son Lue, Grand Mentor to the Crown Prince Yang Ji's son Bi, Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince Pei Kai's son Xian, Junior Mentor to the Crown Prince Zhang Hua's son Yi, and Minister Director Hua Gao's son Heng were assigned to keep company with the crown prince and assist in his guidance.

value.zh: 孫惠
value.en: Sun Hui.
value.literal: Section heading: Sun Hui.

value.zh: 劾案沛王韜獄，未竟，會解結代楊准為刺史，韜因河間王顒屬結。
value.en: He was investigating Prince Pei's man Tao when Xie Jie replaced Yang Zhun as regional inspector; Tao then leaned on Sima Yong, the Prince of Hejian, to bring pressure on Xie Jie.
value.literal: He impeached and investigated the case of Prince of Pei's Tao; it was not finished when Xie Jie replaced Yang Zhun as inspector, and Tao through Prince of Hejian Yong importuned Jie.

value.zh: 結至大會，問主簿史鳳曰：「沛王貴籓，州據何法而擅拘邪？」
value.en: When Xie Jie took up his post he called a full meeting and asked his chief clerk Shi Feng, 'The Prince of Pei is a royal fief—what statute let your office seize him on its own?'
value.literal: When Jie arrived he held a great assembly and asked chief clerk Shi Feng, "The Prince of Pei is a noble princedom—on what law of the province did you dare detain him without authority?"

value.zh: 時頵在坐，對曰：「甲午詔書，刺史銜命，國之外台，其非所部而在境者，刺史並糾。
value.en: Chen Yun, who was in the hall, answered: 'The jiawu edict made the inspector Heaven's agent beyond the capital: anyone inside his circuit, whether or not under his nominal department, falls under his remit.
value.literal: At the time Yun was present and replied, "The jiawu-year edict: the inspector bears charge; beyond the capital he is the state's outer terrace; those who are not of his department but are within his borders—the inspector investigates them all.

value.zh: 事征文墨，前後列上，七被詔書。
value.en: The paperwork went up again and seven imperial replies confirmed the procedure.
value.literal: The affair is verified in documents; forward and backward it was listed and submitted, seven times receiving edict responses.

value.zh: 如州所劾，無有違謬。」
value.en: If the province's impeachment follows that paper trail, it is legally sound.'
value.literal: If it is as the province impeached, there is no violation or error."

value.zh: 結曰：「眾人之言不可妄聽，宜依法窮竟。」
value.en: Xie Jie answered, 'You cannot trust every rumor; investigate to the letter of the law.'
value.literal: Jie said, "The words of the multitude must not be rashly trusted; one should according to law exhaust the case to the end."

value.zh: 又問僚佐曰：「河北白壤膏粱，何故少人士，每以三品為中正？」
value.en: He went on, 'Hebei is fat white farmland—why are there so few eminent families that every third-rank house rates as zhongzheng?'
value.literal: He further asked his staff, "Hebei has white soil and rich fields—why are there few gentlemen, always using third rank as central assessor?"

value.zh: 答曰：「《詩》稱'維嶽降神，生甫及申'。
value.en: Someone replied, 'The 《Book of Odes》 says Heaven sends its finest spirits down from the sacred peaks.
value.literal: They answered, "The 《Book of Odes》 states, 'From the great peak Heaven sent its spirits; it bore Fu and Shen.

value.zh: 夫英偉大賢多出於山澤，河北土平氣均，蓬蒿裁高三尺，不足成林故也。」
value.en: Heroes sprout from rough country; Hebei is flat and tame, its scrub barely shoulder high—no forest, no giants.'
value.literal: Great heroes and grand worthies mostly come from mountains and marshes; Hebei's earth is level and its qi even, mugwort grows only three feet high—not enough to form a forest—that is the reason."

value.zh: 結曰：「張彥真以為汝潁巧辯，恐不及青徐儒雅也。」
value.en: Xie Jie quoted Zhang Yanzhen: 'The clever talkers of Run and Ying cannot rival the classical scholars of Qing and Xu.'
value.literal: Jie said, "Zhang Yanzhen thought the Run-Ying sophists could not match the ru elegance of Qing and Xu."

value.zh: 頵曰：「彥真與元禮不協，故設過言。
value.en: Chen Yun said, 'Yanzhen feuded with Yuanli—that slander was personal, not geography.
value.literal: Yun said, "Yanzhen was not on good terms with Yuanli, therefore he set forth excessive words.

value.zh: 老子、莊周生陳梁，伏羲、傅說、師曠、大項出陽夏，漢魏二祖起於沛譙，准之眾州，莫之與比。」
value.en: Laozi and Zhuang Zhou were Chen and Liang men; Fuxi, Fu Yue, Shi Kuang, and Xiang Yu hailed from Yangxia; the Han and Wei founders rose in Pei and Qiao—name a province that can match that roll call.'
value.literal: Laozi and Zhuang Zhou were born in Chen and Liang; Fuxi, Fu Yue, Shi Kuang, and great Xiang came from Yangxia; the two founders of Han and Wei rose from Pei and Qiao—measured against the host of provinces, none can compare."

value.zh: 結甚異之，曰：「豫州人士常半天下，此言非虛。」
value.en: Xie Jie stared, then said, 'They say half the realm's talent comes from Yuzhou—now I believe it.'
value.literal: Jie greatly marveled at him and said, "The gentlemen of Yu Province are always half the realm—this saying is not empty."

value.zh: 會結遷尚書，結恨不得盡其才用。
value.en: Soon Xie Jie went to the ministry in the capital and regretted he had not used Chen Yun to the full.
value.literal: Before long Jie was transferred to minister; Jie regretted that he could not exhaust his employment of Chen's talent.

value.en: Yang Zhun
value.zh: 楊准

value.event: Yang Zhun was appointed literary aide at the Guangling enfeoffment; no era or year is stated.

value.en: Yang Zhun
value.zh: 楊准

value.event: Xie Jie served as inspector before being killed in AD 300.
